# StaticLambdaBinding

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 5.4" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `StaticLambdaBindingInspection`

A `static` closure or arrow function has no bound object: using `$this` in it,
or calling an instance method of the parent class through `parent::`, fails at
runtime. Either drop `static` or stop relying on the object.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{13,14,17,18,19} [Before]
<?php
class Base {
    public function render() {}
    public static function make() {}
}

class Widget extends Base {
    private $label = 'w';

    public function handlers() {
        return [
            function () { return $this->label; },
            static function () { return strtoupper($this->label); },
            static fn ($s) => $s . $this->label,
            static function () { return fn () => 1; },
            static function () { return function () { return $this->label; }; },
            static function () { return fn () => $this->label; },
            static function ($x) { parent::render($x); },
            static fn () => parent::render(),
            static function () { return parent::make(); },
        ];
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
class Base {
    public function render() {}
    public static function make() {}
}

class Widget extends Base {
    private $label = 'w';

    public function handlers() {
        return [
            function () { return $this->label; },
            function () { return strtoupper($this->label); },
            fn ($s) => $s . $this->label,
            static function () { return fn () => 1; },
            static function () { return function () { return $this->label; }; },
            function () { return fn () => $this->label; },
            function ($x) { parent::render($x); },
            fn () => parent::render(),
            static function () { return parent::make(); },
        ];
    }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 13: Static closures have no $this; remove &#39;static&#39; or avoid $this.</li>
<li>line 14: Static closures have no $this; remove &#39;static&#39; or avoid $this.</li>
<li>line 17: Static closures have no $this; remove &#39;static&#39; or avoid $this.</li>
<li>line 18: Calling an instance method of the parent class requires an object; this closure is static.</li>
<li>line 19: Calling an instance method of the parent class requires an object; this closure is static.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "StaticLambdaBinding": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore StaticLambdaBinding

/**
 * @noinspection StaticLambdaBindingInspection
 */
```
